Server and client observation: outside execution ownership
|
|-- SessionHandler -> Session.Service
|   |-- Commands submit work; HTTP request does not own the agent run
|   |-- get / messages / inbox -> projected snapshots
|   `-- log -> ordered aggregate history, if payloads were retained
`-- EventFeed -> SSE clients
    |-- -> Bus live observation; not historical replay
    |-- Per-subscriber bounded queues
    |   `-- Overflow fails slow subscribers rather than growing memory
    `-- Disconnect releases subscription, not session execution
